findings: learner.components[1]: “It may depict a pig or represent 豭 as a sound element” blurs the visible form with the disputed analysis and gives no plain-language explanation of the proposed sound match. Say that some analyses read the lower form as a pig contributing to the roof-and-livestock scene, while the traditional account treats it as an abbreviation of 豭 because their readings match; clarify that this does not establish the earliest sign’s identity. The component sound comparisons provide the reading evidence.
